scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/chunks',{recursive:true,force:true})" && esbuild ohhi=src/main.ts --bundle --splitting --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire as __ohhiCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __ohhiCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] --log-level=warning
scripts.gen-schemas: esbuild src/gen-schemas.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire as __ohhiCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __ohhiCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/gen-schemas.mjs --log-level=warning && node dist/gen-schemas.mjs
